row.body:
I saved the cloth with a sweet chemical smell for you. The water-treatment trial crew passed Thursday after closing; the rats left the shed, and afterward the clinic stopped answering.

I carried it home because there was nowhere open to return it. The mark did not come off when I tried to wash my hands.

The next morning I looked for a second copy and found only the envelope. I left this one unfolded for whoever came after us.

row.body:
A man sat by the back door and asked for the names of everyone who had come in. I assumed he meant the people still here.

He wanted the earlier customers too. I wrote down the one I knew because she brought her own mug. He crossed out her name, then asked whether I was certain she had arrived.

Her mug is still under the counter. I have not washed it, though I cannot say what that proves.
row.title: The visitor at closing
